entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Karan Singh Dugtal, Advocate for the applicant.

Mr. Lalit Miglani, A.G.A. with Ms. Sangeeta Bhardwaj, Brief
 Holder for the State.

Applicant Ravindra Selal is in judicial custody in Fir No.0119 of 2022, under Section 9 of The
Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, Section 376 Ipc and Section  of the Protection of
Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Kotwali Pithoragarh, District- Pithoragarh.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant married the victim, a young girl of 15 years of age.
The FIR was lodged by a police inspector.
It records that a minor girl was married.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim has not supported the prosecution case at trial; initially, in fact, it was a case of child marriage.
The statement of the victim has been enclosed.
5. Learned State Counsel admits these factual aspects.
6. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

7. The bail application is allowed.
